name: MemPalace
description: A local search layer that stores your past conversations word for word and finds them again by meaning, organized into wings and rooms.
source_note: From its own documentation; nothing installed or tested.

installs_as.value: CLI plus MCP server (also agent skills, Docker)

offline_no_account.value: Yes after setup; first use downloads an embedding model

plain_files.value: No: stored in a vector database (ChromaDB by default)

footprint.value: Medium: local embedding model plus vector store

claude_code.value: Yes: MCP server, auto-save hooks, mining of sessions

codex.value: Yes: auto-save hooks for Codex CLI, bundled plugin

claude_chat.value: Imports exported Claude.ai chats; no chat setup shown

chatgpt_chat.value: Imports exported ChatGPT chats; no chat setup shown

os.value: Docker on Linux, macOS, Windows; also a Python package

survives_compaction.value: Hooks save before context compression; recall by search

outdated_memory.value: On request: a fact can be marked no longer true

license_cost.value: MIT; a separate community-hosted service exists
